ideas.pitch: Real-time agricultural IoT and satellite monitoring platform built specifically for Tamil Nadu regional farming clusters.
ideas.title: TamilNadu-AgroSensor-IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning GeoNex-ATLAS pattern by integrating spatial intelligence and hardware telemetry into an intuitive dashboard tailored for local agricultural districts.

ideas.pitch: Multi-language clinical-grade health triage platform featuring Tamil voice input and offline-first local clinic record synchronization.
ideas.title: Kural-Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the mediscan-ai winning pattern by solving a highly localized language need (Tamil NLP triage) combined with a flawless working demo.

ideas.pitch: GPS-enabled civic grievance tracker and municipal resource allocator designed for Tamil Nadu urban local bodies.
ideas.title: TN-CivicPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the catwalk winning formula of combining a grassroots citizen action app with a live municipal dashboard that judges can test immediately on their phones.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent learning support platform optimized for state-syllabus engineering students across Tamil Nadu colleges.
ideas.title: StateEd-MultiAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the multi-agent workflow pattern seen in greennovation-ai-platform, giving students a structured, curriculum-aligned mentor that is immediately useful for local universities.

ideas.pitch: A transparent supply-chain booking and digital storefront platform connecting traditional Tamil Nadu weaver cooperatives directly to buyers.
ideas.title: LocalHandloom-Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the LuluHackathon winning blueprint of delivering a complete marketplace and booking flow with smooth UX in a strict 48-hour window.
